definitions.explanation: Proceeding in stages or steps rather than all at once.

examples.japanese: {段階的|だんかいてき}に{導入|どうにゅう}していく{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We plan to introduce it in stages.

examples.japanese: {段階的|だんかいてき}な{値上|ねあ}げが{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: A gradual price increase was announced.

examples.japanese: {規制|きせい}を{段階的|だんかいてき}に{緩和|かんわ}する。
examples.english: We will ease regulations step by step.

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {段階的|だんかいてき}に (gradually, in stages)
・Noun: {段階|だんかい} (stage, phase, step)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{段階的|だんかいてき}に{導入|どうにゅう}する (introduce in phases)
・{段階的|だんかいてき}な{移行|いこう} (gradual transition)
・{段階的|だんかいてき}に{進|すす}める (proceed step by step)

USAGE: Often used in business, policy, and technical contexts to describe phased implementation or gradual changes.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{徐々|じょじょ}に: Gradually (emphasizes slowness)
・{段階的|だんかいてき}に: Step by step (emphasizes distinct stages)
